headline: UP Fintech Reports Q3 Revenue of $172.6 Million as Client Assets Reach Record
summary: UP Fintech Holding reported third-quarter revenue of $172.6 million, with net income up 16.4% quarter-on-quarter. Total client assets reached a record $64.8 billion.
why: UP Fintech Holding operates Tiger Brokers, an online brokerage platform providing retail and institutional trading services across global capital markets.
